# Commands

## poe tasks

Run with `uv run poe <task>`.

| Task | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `test` | Fast tests (no real models, no full documents, no Postgres); what CI and cloud sessions run |
| `test-all` | All tests including slow (real models) |
| `fmt` | Auto-fix and format |
| `typecheck` | mypy on the correctness-critical packages |
| `api` | FastAPI on :8000 |
| `record-demo` | Record real chat streams into data/demo_cache (needs Ollama) |
| `gen-openapi` | Write openapi.json (add --check to verify it is current) |
| `docs-gen` | Write the generated reference pages of the docs site (add --check to verify) |
| `docs` | Docs site on :8000 (needs `uv sync --group docs`) |
| `docs-build` | Build the docs site into site/ and fail on warnings |
| `lint` | ruff check and format check |

## Module commands

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `uv run python -m finsight.pipeline build --ipo <id>` | Build one showcase IPO |
| `uv run python -m finsight.pipeline inspect --ipo <id>` | Print a short view of a parsed document (≤ 40 lines) |
| `uv run python -m finsight.jobs run <doc_id> <job_id>` | Run the upload pipeline |
| `uv run python -m finsight.jobs simplify <doc_id>` | Rewrite the queued risks |
| `uv run python -m finsight.jobs sweep` | Delete uploads past retention |
